heads.en: North Korean gold skiing also needs a brand! The gold owner is suspected to be from Europe US Department: a prohibited shipment, North Korean supreme leader Kim Jong-un took his daughter to the ski field with his daughter, and unexpectedly lost sight of the skiing equipment on both parents. From the public view, the gold owner's favorite ski suit, skiboard, is suspected to come from a well-known European brand. The U.S. State Department has pointed out in this regard that ski equipment is a luxury that the United Nations prohibits from entering North Korea, and that even if it turns through third parties, it may be subject to international sanctions. 14 minutes ago, in the international arena, North Korea's gold skiers also wore brand names! The Golden Master is suspected to be in Europe.

heads.t: 洗手間裝針孔偷拍老闆娘洗澡 惡男傳訊勒索嗆：發到你臉書 一名張姓男子前年潛入某住家兼營美髮店的洗手間偷裝針孔攝影機，拍下老闆娘全裸洗澡畫面後，竟藉口「女友想染髮」借用不知情女友的手機加老闆娘LINE好友，隨即傳送偷拍影片恐嚇勒索「要付錢處理，還是發到你臉書與各大群組？」，檢警循線查扣針孔攝影機送辦，張男起初狡辯影像是從網路下載，卻因畫面解析度極差又僅拍到側臉、一般人根本無法辨識身分而當場穿幫，基隆地院審理後依無故攝錄他人性影像、恐嚇取財未遂等罪，判處應執行有期徒刑9月，得易科罰金27萬元。 15 分鐘前｜社會 洗手間裝針孔偷拍老闆娘洗澡 惡男傳訊勒索嗆：發到你臉書 15 分鐘前｜社會

heads.t: 《反骨男孩》語謙罹乳癌「最新病榻照」曝光 確診第111天催淚長文吐心聲 31歲網紅團體「反骨男孩」前成員陳語謙（語謙），過去也是節目《大學生了沒》班底，日前證實罹患乳癌。今（25）日是她確診乳癌第111天，語謙PO出在病床上的照片，並透過ChatGPT發想的指令，以第三人稱的細膩視角，向外界剖析自己罹癌後的心路歷程，並對大家喊話：「請你不要只記得她曾經多麼辛苦。請你記得，她曾經那麼用力地笑過、愛過、漂亮過，也那麼認真地期待著明天。」真摯字句惹哭網友。 19 分鐘前｜娛樂 《反骨男孩》語謙罹乳癌「最新病榻照」曝光 確診第111天催淚長文吐心聲 19 分鐘前｜娛樂

heads.en: Christmas Dream Toys! Interacting, creatively detonating a £2.6 billion business, Christmas is approaching, and the world's parents are beginning to break their minds to pick out gifts. In the age of artificial intelligence and 3C full-time capture of life, the British Toys Retailing Association published its new Christmas DreamToys list, which broke human glasses. The child's favorite is not just a high-tech, but rather a live interactive toy that can do it and actually touch it, a two-handed boom that moves the local toy market to produce an annual 13% bright-eyed score sheet. Thirty-four minutes ago, Christmas Dream Toys came out! Physical interaction, creative hand-activation of a £2.6 billion business 34 minutes ago
